SUMMARY
======================================================================
handout checks flagged: ['E2 Ts K=20']
Known handout text/figure mismatches (Project 1 text vs its own screenshots):
  - text 'response time from 3.4 to 1.5 s'; screenshot p.4 shows 3.1 (2/3.1 = 0.645 = table crossover; 2/3.4 = 0.588)
  - text 'settling time of 4 seconds', 'overshoot of zero'; table p.4: 3.45 s, 0.401 %
  - Fig. 4.23(b) script sets f=0.5 but uses b in den1=[J,b] (undefined variable in a fresh session)
  - Table 4.3 settling at K = 20: 1.0 s; exact 2 % settling 0.91 s
